what: CFA control pre-registration, written before the run

outcome_1_G1_vs_G2.why_it_carries_the_weight: identical sampling and identical processing on both sides, so it is immune to the S = 0.83 -> 0.415 confound
outcome_1_G1_vs_G2.statistic: chi2 of (axis_G1 - axis_G2) against zero across rho bins, 5 dof
outcome_1_G1_vs_G2.AGREE_if: chi2 < 11.07 (p > 0.05) -> the CFA lattice injects no directional term
outcome_1_G1_vs_G2.DIFFER_means: a directional term from the lattice or the sampling, contaminating every shape measurement on this grid; outcome 2 must not then be read as though the grid were clean

outcome_2_CFA_vs_debayered.SAME_means: the demosaic is NOT producing the rotation; the named alternative dies and 'no field-constant optical component' stands alone
outcome_2_CFA_vs_debayered.DIFFERENT_means: AMBIGUOUS between the demosaic and severe undersampling (S ~ 0.415, below Kannawadi's 0.5). This arm cannot separate them and will not attribute.

outcome_3_constancy_fit_on_CFA.REJECTS_means: the gate failure is independent of the demosaic
outcome_3_constancy_fit_on_CFA.DOES_NOT_REJECT_means: produced by the demosaic OR by the sampling change — same ambiguity, same refusal

PRE_REGISTRATION.absorbed_and_not_under_test: T scales by 1/4 on the half-sized grid and kappa was calibrated at S ~ 0.83; both are GLOBAL scales on T absorbed by the free f, so neither touches the constancy question. f stays unquotable.
